Attached: 1 image

Claude generates clean HTML drafts fast, but re-prompting for last-mile fixes burns quota and often shifts spacing or tables below. Once you have a standalone .html (not uncompiled JSX), uploading it to a visual canvas to delete draft banners, fix exact metrics/links, and verify mobile 375x812 before exporting HTML or PNG is much cleaner.
